text: For a discrete-time map x_{t+1} = f(x_t), what defines a fixed point x*?
choices: A state x* where the trajectory moves fastest
A state x* where the Jacobian Df(x*) equals the identity matrix
A state x* satisfying f(x*) = x*, so it is unchanged under the map
A state x* satisfying f(x*) = 0, so the vector field vanishes
explanation: For a discrete-time map a fixed point satisfies f(x*) = x* - the state maps to itself. f(x*) = 0 (option 3) is the continuous-time equilibrium condition, not the map condition; the Jacobian-identity and 'fastest' options are unrelated.
